title: Tiny, cute toothbrush
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <g transform='rotate(-20 50 50)'>
    <!-- handle -->
    <rect x='42' y='48' width='12' height='42' rx='6' fill='#4FC3F7'/>
    <rect x='42' y='48' width='5' height='42' rx='3' fill='#8ED8FA'/>
    <!-- neck -->
    <rect x='43' y='36' width='10' height='14' rx='4' fill='#29B6F6'/>
    <!-- head -->
    <rect x='40' y='18' width='16' height='22' rx='7' fill='#4FC3F7'/>
    <rect x='40' y='18' width='7' height='22' rx='5' fill='#8ED8FA'/>
    <!-- bristles -->
    <g fill='#FFFFFF'>
      <rect x='43' y='8' width='3' height='11' rx='1.5'/>
      <rect x='48' y='10' width='3' height='9' rx='1.5'/>
      <rect x='53' y='8' width='3' height='11' rx='1.5'/>
    </g>
    <g fill='#B3E5FC'>
      <rect x='43' y='8' width='1.5' height='11' rx='1'/>
      <rect x='48' y='10' width='1.5' height='9' rx='1'/>
      <rect x='53' y='8' width='1.5' height='11' rx='1'/>
    </g>
    <!-- toothpaste dab -->
    <ellipse cx='49.5' cy='6.5' rx='7' ry='3' fill='#FF7EB3'/>
    <ellipse cx='47' cy='5.5' rx='3' ry='1.4' fill='#FFB3D1'/>
    <!-- little sparkle -->
    <circle cx='62' cy='24' r='2' fill='#FFF176'/>
  </g>
</svg>
